purpose: Known-answer test vectors for CPG U1 tooling v3. Historical public data only; no study commitment, seed, key or transaction of this study.

bitcoin.source: https://blockstream.info/api (block headers, block hashes, block txids, raw transactions, Merkle proof, decoded transaction)
bitcoin.self_verifying: Header hashes are recomputed (SHA-256d) and checked against proof of work and linkage by the self-test; the 3050 txids reproduce the block 840000 Merkle root; transaction ids are recomputed from the raw bytes.

files.tx_840000_index5_decoded.json: source decoding of index 5 (prevout, size, weight) used as an independent comparison
files.merkleproof_840000_index5.json: Merkle branch and position for index 5

drand.self_verifying: Each round's BLS signature is verified offline against the pinned group public key; randomness = sha256(signature).

files.quicknet_chain_info.json: chain info (public key, period 3, genesis 1692803367, scheme bls-unchained-g1-rfc9380)
